name: Earthkin
description: Earthkin are descended from earth elementals. They are humanoids whose bodies are a combination of flesh and earth.

features.name: Stoneskin
features.description: Gain a +1 bonus to your Armor Score and Damage Thresholds.

features.name: Immoveable
features.description: While your feet are touching the ground, you cannot be lifted or moved against your will.
